title: Shipment detail: read the parcel first
text: Check the delivery stage, customer payment status, addresses and weight. Pickup OTP appears only when returned. Rider identity, vehicle and earnings are shown separately.

title: Record customer cash against the right bill
text: Open the due bill’s cash receipt form. Check the amount and collect the required reference and evidence before submitting. This records customer payment; it is separate from rider earnings.

title: Customer checkout and payment links
text: When enabled, Get payment link retrieves checkout for a due bill. Generate new payment link checks whether the previous checkout was abandoned. Copy the ready link, then refresh payment status. Never assume that opening a link settles the bill.
